PLSsemLab 1.0.1: new module icon and logo in the visual line of the suite (MokkenLab, EGAnetLab): two constructs (blue circles) predict a third (amber circle). Includes `docs/logo/analysis-plssemlab.svg`, a 74 × 44 icon for jamovi's Analyses ribbon. No changes to the analyses: results are identical to 1.0.0.

The attached `.jmo` is built for jamovi 2.7.41 on Windows (R 4.5.0). Changes: see `NEWS.md`.
